      Targeting the Two Root Causes of Aging: Wrinkles & Pigmentation

      As we age, the skin’s renewal slows from within —

      • Collagen collapse: fine lines deepen and skin loses its firmness.
      • Pigment buildup: dark spots and uneven tone begin to surface.
      • Structural shifts: contours fade and the jawline softens.

      These silent changes gradually reshape your face — until one day, it shows.


      The good news:

      Most of these visible signs can be effectively reversed with DermRays Revive, helping your skin restore its youthful firmness, clarity, and radiance from within.

      How DermRays Revive Works
      Boost Collagen, Reclaim Firmness
      • Gently heats collagen fibers in the dermis to contract them and stimulate new growth
      • Fine lines smooth out, skin becomes firmer and plumper over time

      Fade Spots, Reveal Radiance
      • Targets pigment deep in the skin, breaking it into particles cleared naturally by the body
      • Dark spots fade, complexion appears more even and radiant

      Multi-Target Laser Action (1064nm NIR)

      • Collagen fibers: contracts & stimulates new growth
      • Hemoglobin: improves microcirculation for a healthy glow
      • Melanin: breaks down excess pigment
      • Water: boosts cell metabolism & repair

            Frequently Asked Questions
            What advantages does the DermRays Revive have compared to the NIRA and LYMA lasers?

            DermRays Revive vs. NIRA Pro:
            - The NIRA uses a 1450nm wavelength laser, which primarily promotes collagen regeneration, improving skin texture.

            - The DermRays Revive uses a 1064nm laser, which not only promotes collagen regeneration but also reduces melanin, improving both skin texture and uneven skin tone.

            - Additionally, the DermRays Revive has a higher energy density (10 J/cm²), 2.78 times higher than the NIRA (3.6 J/cm² per pulse), making it more efficient.

            DermRays Revive vs. LYMA Laser:
            - Compared to the low-energy LYMA Laser, the DermRays Revive has an energy density over 100 times greater, allowing for faster wrinkle reduction and skin tightening.

            - The 1064nm wavelength of the DermRays Revive is more effective in stimulating collagen regeneration in the dermis layer.

            Who can use the DermRays Revive? Are there any restrictions regarding skin tone, age, or gender?

            The DermRays Revive is suitable for all skin tones.

            As a laser device, it is recommended for use by adults aged 18 and above.

            Is the DermRays Revive a fractional laser device?

            The DermRays Revive uses a uniform light spot rather than a fractional pattern. Compared to home-use fractional lasers, the DermRays Revive has the following advantages:

            Larger pulses penetrate deeper into the skin, targeting deeper layers to break down melanin and stimulate collagen regeneration, effectively improving pigmentation and skin texture.

            In contrast, fractional lasers primarily target the epidermis, focusing on removing pigmentation and improving pore size.

            The DermRays Revive has fewer side effects, with minimal redness or sensitivity after use, and almost no pain during treatment, making it easier to maintain a consistent skincare routine.

            Which areas can the DermRays Revive be used on? Can it be used around the eyes and lips, neck, and chest?

            The DermRays Revive is designed for facial skincare. Please avoid using it on the eyelids, lips, moles, birthmarks, or any skin with infections, burns, or cuts.

            It can also be used on other body areas, but please avoid the neck near the thyroid, the chest area, private regions, and areas with thick or dense hair.

            Is there a risk of burns when using the DermRays Revive on areas with hair or wrinkles?

            For areas with thicker hair and hair colors in specific ranges (darker hair), it is not recommended to use the DermRays Revive in wrinkle-prone areas, as the hair follicles may contain more melanin, which could increase the risk of burns.

            Does DermRays Revive hurt?

            For most individuals, the treatment process is virtually painless. For first-time users, we recommend starting with level 1 and try higher level if you find it tolerable.

            When should DermRays Revive not be used?

            -On moles.
            -On infected, burned, or injured skin.
            -If you've had a skin laser treatment within the past 30 days.
            -If you're sensitive to sunlight.

            If you have any other questions, please feel free to email us at support@dermrays.com

            Can the DermRays Revive be used after cosmetic treatments like microcurrent or hyaluronic acid injections? Any precautions?

            -After a microcurrent treatment, wait at least 12 hours before using the DermRays Revive, provided there is no visible redness or discomfort.
            -After a Pico Laser treatment, wait 30 days before using the DermRays Revive.
            -After hyaluronic acid or other injectable treatments, it is recommended to wait 30 days before using the DermRays Revive.

            Frequency of Use?

            DermRays Revive typically requires consistent use for optimal results. We recommend the following frequency:
            3-4 times per week for the first 2 weeks
            2-3 times per week for the subsequent 3 weeks
            Once or twice a month thereafter

            Nighttime Use:
            For the best results, we recommend using DermRays Revive at night after completing your skincare routine.

            Tailor Frequency to Individual Needs:
            Due to differences in skin type, treatment goals, and energy levels, users are advised to adjust the frequency of use based on individual variations while adhering to the recommended guidelines.

            Avoid Overuse:
            Excessive laser treatments can pose risks. Therefore, it's important to use the device within recommended limits to prevent potential complications.

            Precautions for Use?

            Eye Safety:
            - Avoid use near eyes, eyelids, or eye sockets.
            - Do not stare at the emission window when the device is powered on.
            - Avoid laser emission towards the eyes.

            Skin Safety:
            - Do not use on infected, burned, or injured skin.
            - Avoid use if you've had a skin laser treatment within the past 30 days.
            - Avoid use if you're sensitive to sunlight.
            - Avoid treating moles.
            - Apply sunscreen (physical or chemical) after use.

            Operation:
            - Do not overuse; follow recommended frequency.

            If you have any other questions, please feel free to email us at support@dermrays.com

            Is it dangerous without UV glasses?

            Absolutely not. DermRays Revive features an skin sensing system that emits laser only when the emission window is firmly pressed against the skin, ensuring no light leakage.

            Note: Do not stare at the emission window when the device is powered on.
            Avoid laser emission towards the eyes.

            Can the DermRays Revive be used alongside a laser hair removal device?

            If you purchase both the DermRays Revive and a hair removal device, it is advised not to use them on the same skin area on the same day.

            For users with lighter skin tones (Fitzpatrick Skin Types 1-3), you can use the DermRays Revive on one day and the hair removal device the next, as their skin has less melanin and is less prone to laser-induced burns.

            For users with darker skin tones (Fitzpatrick Skin Types 4-6), it is recommended to wait at least one day between treatments.
